735.string: capacity (contained in a standard graduated flask)           #00398
735.note_text: The expression « filled to this scale mark », means that the meniscus formed by the water in the neck of the flask, is so adjusted that the horizontal plane passing through the upper edge of the scale mark, is tangential to the lowest point of the meniscus, when viewed in this plane.

733.string: capacity (contained in a standard graduated flask)           #00398
733.note_text: the capacity « contained » in a standard graduated flask, corresponding to a scale mark (designated capacity « In »), is equal to the volume of water which the flask contains at the reference temperature, when filled to this scale mark
